'''Jérôme Galon''' is a French [[biologist]]. He is Director of Research of Exceptional Class (DRCE) at ''Institut National de la Santé et de la Recherche Médicale'' ([[INSERM]]). He is also an entrepreneur and co-founder of HalioDx.

==Education==
Galon received his Ph.D. degree (Doctorat ès science) with a specialty in immunology in 1996 and did postdoctoral work at the [[National Institute of Health]] (NIH), in Bethesda (USA) between 1997 and 2001. Since 2001, he has been working at the Cordeliers Research Center, where he has been the Director of the INSERM Laboratory Integrative Cancer Immunology since 2009.<ref name=CV>[http://www.ici.upmc.fr/cvGalon.shtml Official CV at Laboratory of Integrative Cancer Immunology]</ref>

==Scientific contributions==
{{BLP unsourced section|date=June 2023}}
His work aims at a better understanding of the tumor microenvironment and the dynamics of the immune response in human tumors. His laboratory has identified and demonstrated the importance of the immune contexture against cancer. He defined the [[Immunoscore]] as a new method for routine clinical assessment of the prognosis of patients with cancer.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jerome Galon, Ph. D. |url=https://www.science.org/content/author/jerome-galon-phd}}</ref>

==Awards and recognition==

* NIH Excellence Research Award (1999)
* Prix Shaeverbeke from [[Fondation de France]] (2008)
* Prix Rose Lamarca from [[Fondation pour la recherche médicale]] (2008)
* [[William B. Coley Award]] of the [[Cancer Research Institute]] (2010)
* Prix Simone et Cino Del Duca from the French Academy of Sciences [[Académie des sciences (France)|Académie des sciences]] (2011)
* Prix Gallet et Breton from the French Academy of Medicine [[Académie nationale de médecine|Académie de médecine]] (2011)
* [[European Inventor Award]] (2019)<ref>{{Cite web |last=Cara |first=Graziella |date=2019-06-20 |title=Inserm Research Director Jérôme Galon Wins European Inventor Award 2019 |url=https://presse.inserm.fr/en/inserm-research-director-jerome-galon-wins-european-inventor-award-2019/59091/ |access-date=2024-07-25 |website=Inserm Newsroom |language=en-US}}</ref>
* Team Science Award from the Society for immunotherapy of cancer (SITC, USA) (2020)
* Fondazione Melanoma Award (Italy) (2020)
* Jean Valade Award (Senior Medical Prize from Fondation de France) (2020) 
* [[Louis-Jeantet Prize]] (Switzerland) (2021)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prestigious Louis-Jeantet prize for NKI immunologist Ton Schumacher |url=https://www.avl.nl/en/news/2021/prestigious-louis-jeantet-prize-for-nki-immunologist-ton-schumacher/ |access-date=2024-07-25 |website=www.avl.nl |language=en}}</ref>
* [[Galien Prize]] (2021) <ref>[https://prixgalien.fr/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/prix-galien-historique-laureats.pdf]</ref>
* Duquesne Prize, from La Ligue contre le Cancer (2022) 
* Jérôme Galon was decorated as Knight of the Legion of Honor for exceptional INSERM career (2020) <ref>[https://www.legiondhonneur.fr/sites/default/files/promotion_de_la_legion_dhonneur_du_1er_janvier_2020.pdf]</ref>
